title: Symrise signs agreement to divest its Terpene Ingredients business to Mutares SE & Co. KGaA
summary: — Positions AmeriTerpenes LLC for long-term growth under Mutares' ownership — Advances the ONE Symrise strategy through continued portfolio management — Secures long-term supply, customer service, and commercial partnership between Symrise and AmeriTerpenes
